newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY FIRMER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY FIRMER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer on most key currencies at the close of Monday's interbank session, foreign exchange dealers said.
"Nothing much happened today but we saw a number of (foreign) currency) inflows into the market," one dealer said to explain the appreciation on the key U.S. dollar.
The local unit finished the day at 11.3725/3825 on the U.S. dollar a cent firmer compared to Friday's 11.3825/3925 and was at 19.2200/2800 from 19.3000/3280 versus sterling.
Against the mark it was at 6.3400/3600 from 6.4555/4565 but was little changed versus the rand at 2.5000/5100 from 2.5000/5010.
